title: 'Free-riding on our work’: Dictionary sues OpenAI for using copyrighted materials to train ChatGPT​ | Euronews
summary: Merriam-Webster and Encyclopedia Britannica filed a lawsuit against OpenAI for allegedly using copyrighted material from their content to train ChatGPT, resulting in AI-generated summaries and hallucinations that resemble their content.
sentiment_reason: The lawsuit accuses OpenAI of copyright infringement and misuse of content, which could negatively impact their reputation and potentially lead to financial and legal consequences.
